subject: 360 Achievement Rules - Even the OXM doesn't seem to know!?
author: ZombieTron
body:
I was having another look around the web today to see if there was anything new or any further confirmation of the Xbox360Achievements.org story.. I found this link from the Official Xbox Magazine HERE where they report the news from the Xbox360Achievements.org story as tho even they don't know what the official rules are??? I would have thought they would be able to get confirmation from Xbox direct as they are the Official magazine? So, it seems like this may all be internet hooey and we may never get to the truth about what the actual rules for achievements are, or what the guidelines are that CG are following...

My search for the truth continues... 🤓

subject: Still confused about Achievements...
author: ZombieTron
body:
I asked Matt Webster on Twitter:

ZombieTron@TheWebsterHoff so I finally know the maximum achievements allowed for 360: http://digg.com/u11pri so why don't you use more? Thanks, Zombs

And this was the response:

TheWebsterHoff@ZombieTron We work within guidelines established directly with Microsoft. If we were able to do more, we would.

Which doesn't really make any sense if the guidelines from MS are 250gs per DLC pack over up to 10 achievements... so I am still confused! 🤷

subject: New Achievement Rules for 360...
author: ZombieTron
body:
or Yes! Criterion Games could have put in equivalent achievements for ALL of the PS3 trophies but they didn't so I'm not happy!

Thanks to Mcmax for sending me a link to Kotaku over the weekend, as it finally gives a maximum number for Achievements for 360 games.

The maximum number is much higher then those in Burnout Paradise. 80 Achievements out of the box (Orange Box being the exception). And a further 10 Achievements for each DLC pack. Why CG has only put in 3 achievements for each DLC pack is beyond me! Here are the new articles on this subject:

Xbox 360 Achievements.Org - The New Rules Explained

Kotaku - 360 Achievements Partially Explained

subject: Bias in favor of PS3?
author: EdHanson
body:
I've often thought that CG views the XBOX 360 as the red-headed stepchild of consoles. Most, if not all, of the times that they show in-game footage or mention controls, they refer to the PS3 version. And after seeing how they deny us achievements with the add-on packs, citing "limits", I am almost certain of it. Legendary Cars, no achievements, Toy Cars, no achievements, Boost Specials, no achievements, and now only 5 achievements on the island vs 10 PS3 Trophies. If there were limits, as they say, how were they able to add them to the island at all? Hmmm?

This is still one of my favorite games, but come on, Criterion. Make with the achievements already.
